description: This PHP source file defines the Aws\Session\SesClient class, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES). It includes method annotations for SES operations, credential handling utilities, and internal helper functions.

classes.name: SesClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon SES, providing methods for email-related operations and credential utilities.

methods.name: generateSmtpPassword
methods.description: Generates an SMTP password from AWS credentials using HMAC with SHA-256.

methods.name: generateSmtpPasswordV4
methods.description: Generates an AWS Signature Version 4 SMTP password based on credentials, region, and specific signing steps.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Internal helper method to perform HMAC SHA-256 signing.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Applies documentation filters and returns service and documentation model instances.
